title: Fills Ordered outside Tailwise Autoship and Pharmacy Spacing
content:
**Tailwise Pharmacy note — one-time-order fills alongside a prescription Autoship**

Fills ordered outside the Autoship shorten the dosing days between shipments of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship. The fills are read from the Tailwise Pharmacy fill records: fills dispensed through the one-time-order channel, of the linked prescription or of the prescription it renewed.

| One-time-order fills of the linked prescription or the prescription it renewed, dispensed in the last twelve months | Days taken away |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 6 |
| exactly 1 | 3 |
| none | none |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

Fills dispensed through the Autoship itself are not one-time-order fills and do not count.

**Hypothetical record.** One one-time-order fill of the earlier prescription seven months ago and one of the linked prescription last month: two fills, 6 days taken away.
